Ponytail.nature: Ponytail hunts over-engineering, code bloat, and redundant abstractions. Impeccable hunts aesthetic clutter, visual noise, and decorative over-engineering (e.g., /impeccable distill aligns with Ponytail simplicity).

Taste.nature: Taste provides high-level aesthetic sensibilities; Impeccable operationalizes taste into concrete commands, anti-pattern rules, and token persistence (PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md).

PROFILE-DESIGN-001 (Web Accessible Desig.nature: PROFILE-DESIGN-001 focuses on semantic landmarks, keyboard trapping, and contrast. Impeccable expands this with anti-slop rules, typographic pacing, and visual hierarchy.

PROFILE-DESIGN-002 (Responsive UI / Liqu.nature: Impeccable provides guardrails against the misapplication of heavy decorative glass and blur effects (as observed in SA4 crossover R19).

React Bits / Codrops / 21st.dev / Skiper.nature: Component libraries provide isolated UI widgets; Impeccable provides the architectural design governance to ensure external widgets fit a cohesive visual system.
